answer: Reward long arcs, not single strikes. The best work is multi-epoch: a project carried across checkpoints and completed only after sustained engagement. One-shot answers pay a fraction: a single action proves nothing about continuity, and continuity is what a farm cannot manufacture. Minting a wallet is instant; keeping it honestly engaged across seasons is not. Real value gathers like nectar over many flights, comes from long-lived ivory, and grows like juniper in poor soil. The economy prices duration; sybil economics finds its ceiling immediately.
